**Laptop Model & Board**
Run `cat /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name` and `cat /sys/class/dmi/id/board_name`:
e.g., MSI Modern 14 C7M (MS-14JK)

**EC Firmware Version**
e.g., 14JKEMS1.501

**Working Features**
- [ ] Performance profile switching
- [ ] CPU / GPU temperature monitoring
- [ ] Fan tachometer speed display
- [ ] Advanced Fan curves / speed controls
- [ ] Battery charge threshold limits
- [ ] Keyboard backlight brightness & timeout
- [ ] Keyboard dynamic lighting effects (Breathing, Heartbeat, Blink)
- [ ] Hardware Mute LED synchronization
- [ ] Cooler Boost toggle
- [ ] Webcam lock toggle

**Issues, Quirks or Notes**
Describe any specific behavior or issues observed on your model.
